title: Service authentication
recommendation: Use the shared OIDC identity provider and validate audience and issuer.
excerpt: All service entry points must authenticate using the shared OIDC provider.

title: Encryption at rest
recommendation: Enable AES-256 storage encryption with managed keys.
excerpt: Persistent application databases must use AES-256 encryption at rest.

title: Service telemetry
recommendation: Instrument service boundaries with OpenTelemetry traces and metrics.
excerpt: Production services must emit OpenTelemetry traces and metrics.

title: Default retention
excerpt: The default database retention period is 30 days.

title: Payments retention addendum
recommendation: Confirm the approved retention period with the data owner.
excerpt: Database retention is 90 days. This draft does not define an exception hierarchy.
